The V2 runbook moves STRC to Alpaca, identifies Saturn Fund Ltd., Saturn Global Capital Investments Ltd. and Saturn Vault Corporation, and instructs dating a deed of gift, but its planning text does not establish executed legal rights. Whole-book custody safeguards and provider shares are unknown. Ondo family bankruptcy-remoteness and security-agent claims do not prove sUSDat holder priority against any Saturn entity.
